# origincloud_location_regions (Data Source)

Lists every region that has a zone, in catalog order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "origincloud_location_regions" "all" {}

output "regions" {
  value = data.origincloud_location_regions.all.regions[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `regions` (Attributes List) Every region that has a zone, in catalog order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))

<a id="nestedatt--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) The name the console shows, such as `EU Central 1`.
- `name` (String) The region's resource name, `regions/eu-central1`. Its last segment is the region a regional host is named after, `{service}.{region}.origincloudapis.eu`.
- `zones` (List of String) The region's zones, `zones/{zone}`, in catalog order.
